request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir backing, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, drums, majestic and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Great is the Lord in His holy place
Greatly to be praised in this holy space
In the city of our God He reigns
His holy mountain bears the weight of praise

[Pre-Chorus]
Beautiful in its heights to all the earth
Mount Zion rises with a sacred worth
On the far northern slopes the King resides
In the city where His glory abides

[Chorus]
God is within her citadels strong
He has shown himself the fortress song
He is the shield and the safe retreat
Where the kings of the earth meet in defeat

[Verse]
Look how the kings have assembled here
They advanced together in their fear
But the great King holds the city fast
His fortress stands against all that lasts

[Chorus]
God is within her citadels strong
He has shown himself the fortress song
He is the shield and the safe retreat
Where the kings of the earth meet in defeat

[Bridge]
Joy of all the earth this mountain brings
The city of the great King in its wings
Greatly praised in the holy ground
Where the Lord has made His fortress found

[Outro]
Great is the Lord in the city of God
His holy mountain is the joy of all abroad
